Kforce has a client seeking a Software Test Automation Engineer in Ann Arbor, Michigan.

Position Summary:
The Software Test Automation Engineer designs, builds, and maintains automated test frameworks for AUTOSAR-based embedded software. This role focuses on test strategy, automation, and validation rather than feature development. The engineer expands coverage across SIL, HIL, and vehicle environments, integrates testing into CI/CD, and supports functional safety and development process requirements.

Key Responsibilities:
 
  Develop and maintain automated test suites for AUTOSAR BSW, including CAN, SOME/IP, SWC integration, time synchronization, and GPIO processing 
  Build reusable test automation frameworks, harnesses, stimulus/measurement tools, and test data pipelines 
  Expand automated coverage across SIL, HIL, and vehicle environments 
  Integrate automated testing into CI/CD and define build/merge gates and scheduled testing 
  Triage failures and distinguish test, environment/tooling, flaky behavior, and software defects 
  Maintain traceability between test cases, requirements, and results 
  Use CANoe, CANalyzer, or equivalent tools for protocol-level testing and diagnostics 
  Collaborate with development, systems, and safety teams on test criteria and automation priorities 
  Report coverage, automation progress, defect trends, and release readiness 
  Improve test infrastructure reliability, speed, and maintainability 

 
Expected Scope:
 
  Own assigned automated test suites and CI/CD validation workflows 
  Drive coverage from SIL through HIL and, where applicable, vehicle testing 
  Validate AUTOSAR configuration, integration, and feature implementation rather than developing the underlying software 
  Ensure test evidence supports functional safety and ASPICE-aligned reviews 
  Identify automation and coverage gaps and independently implement solutions 
 
 
  Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent practical experience 
  3+ years of hands-on experience building or maintaining automated test frameworks for embedded or automotive software 
  Strong proficiency in Python or a similar scripting/automation language for test tooling, harnesses, and CI-integrated test scripts 
  Working knowledge of AUTOSAR Classic architecture & Basic Software (BSW) concepts sufficient to design meaningful test cases 
  Experience testing or validating automotive communication protocols such as CAN, with familiarity with SOME/IP or similar service-oriented communication 
  Experience with SIL and/or HIL test environments, including test bench setup, stimulus generation, & results capture 
  Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines such as Jenkins, GitLab CI or equivalent 
  Ability to independently triage test failures and distinguish tooling/environment issues from software defects 
  Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document test frameworks and results 
  Experience testing ADAS, autonomous vehicle, or other safety-critical embedded systems 
  Experience with Vector CANoe, CANalyzer, or comparable automotive network simulation, testing, and diagnostic tools 
  Experience with embedded debugging/test tooling such as Lauterbach Trace32, iSYSTEM winIDEA, or JTAG-based tools 
  Experience working within functional safety processes, including test-related safety work products 
  Experience with ASPICE-aligned development & verification processes 
  Familiarity with AUTOSAR tooling such as PREEvision or Vector DaVinci and how configuration changes affect test scope 
  Experience with test result dashboards, coverage reporting, or test management tools 
  Experience mentoring engineers on test automation practices/establishing test automation standards
